title: The Hunt for Surok (miniquest)
start: Speak to Surok by the statue of Saradomin, east of Varrock.

items.t: Chaos talisman, chaos tiara, chaos talisman staff, omni-talisman, or a wicked hood with a chaos talisman stored inside.

recommended.t: Combat equipment to fight a strong level 107 ork who is resistant to range attacks and survive taking multiple hits from different types of monsters.
An Anti-dragon shield or antifire potion, super energy potions, and antipoisons are useful in the tunnels.
A one-click teleport such as the ectophial or magic tablets.
A way to restore run energy, such as mint cakes or an Explorer's ring.
The salt-water spring in Oo'glog if you've completed As a First Resort.
The salt-water treatment at the spa pool if you have a tier 1 or higher Spa.
A stamina potion if you have level 77 Herblore.
Have the Endurance relic power activated at the mysterious monolith.

rewards.t: Ability to slay Bork (for Summoning charms, big bones and gems) in the Chaos Tunnels
The first kill gives 30000 Slayer XP
Bork will drop a femur bone from the Odd Old Man's Fur 'n Seek wish list, if you have not already looted one from General Graardor.
Ability to use 6 new portals within the Chaos Tunnels that were previously locked by Surok.

steps.t: Talk to Surok Magis outside the Tunnel of Chaos, at the Saradomin statue south of Jolly Boar Inn, south of Fort Forinthry. If he's not there, click dig on the statue, then enter and leave.
After the cutscene, follow him into the tunnel.
Follow him into the portal in the western room (where Dakh'thoulan Aegis is).
Follow Surok through the Chaos Tunnels portals in the route in the above map.

sub.t: Be aware that there are aggressive monsters, dragons, and prayer-draining monsters on the way. It is recommended to bring food and combat equipment.
You may be randomly teleported by a portal - if so, locate yourself on the map and make your way back to the route.

p: Footprints leading up to a portal.
Surok summons wolves to do his dirty work.
Surok ordering his two wolves to kill the player.

steps.t: You need to see three cutscenes along the route.
Enter the final portal in the dagannoth room.

p: Bork looming over the player after being summoned by Surok.

get_inside.text: Varrock lodestone is located by the south gate.

Varrock Teleport or the teletab teleports to the main square. The destination can be changed to southern Grand Exchange entrance (requires Easy Varrock achievements) or north-east church (requires Elite Varrock achievements).
A Grand Exchange Teleport, ring of wealth, ring of fortune, or luck of the dwarves can be used to teleport to the Grand Exchange.

Varrock has four main gates, all of which are open to the public. Each is guarded by several level 36 guards, although they are not aggressive. The north gate can be found near the Wilderness wall and is commonly used by those travelling to Wilderness Crater or exploring the Wilderness. The east gate can be found after following the northern path at the crossroads near northern Al Kharid. The west gate can be reached by travelling east from Gunnarsgrunn. The south gate can be reached by travelling north-west from Lumbridge. Near it is the Stone Circle, where many level 7 and 20 dark wizards can be found.

There are also several other less-official entrances. By travelling north from the road east of the Gunnarsgrunn, players can enter the Grand Exchange, and from there the Varrock Palace grounds. An Agility shortcut north-west of the Grand Exchange can be used by members with 21 agility, running two-way between Varrock and Edgeville.
